import re

def parse(lines):
    funcs = []
    fl = []
    syms = []
    sl = []
    skip = []
    cur = None
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        s = l.strip()
        if not s:
            continue
        if s.startswith('All ') and s.endswith(':'):
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^File (.+):$', s)
        if m:
            cur = m.group(1)
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        if s.startswith('Non-debugging symbols'):
            cur = None
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^(\d+):\s+(.*?);?\s*$', l)
        if m:
            funcs.append({'File': cur, 'Line': int(m.group(1)), 'Signature': m.group(2)})
            fl.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^(0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)\s+(\S.*?)\s*$', s)
        if m:
            syms.append({'Address': m.group(1), 'Symbol': m.group(2)})
            sl.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^\s*(\S.*?);\s*$', l)
        if m and cur is not None:
            funcs.append({'File': cur, 'Line': '', 'Signature': m.group(1)})
            fl.append(i)
    blocks = []
    if funcs:
        blocks.append({'name': 'functions', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': fl, 'records': funcs})
    if syms:
        blocks.append({'name': 'non_debugging_symbols', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': sl, 'records': syms})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
